owner: append-only log (router-private JSONL; the event-sourced TRUTH; machine-local, never published)
rationale: The feedback log is the event-sourced TRUTH from which intent-map.json is a derived projection. It is frozen NOW, in P0, because C0 must not write event #1 against an unfrozen schema: a later reshape would make accumulated learning unreplayable (silent loss). Each line is one append-only JSON object. `operator_choice` is the five-outcome operator model and `outcome` is the verified real-world result (verify-real-outcome, not the router's guess). Both enums EXTEND additively (LOCKED). Additive OPTIONAL keys allowed within v1.

C1.note: Marks a line whose utterance/correction was redacted before persistence (consented/redacted transcript seeding). Additive OPTIONAL key.
Reference to the explicit, per-run, revocable consent that authorized seeding this line from a transcript. Additive OPTIONAL key.

additive_note: FROZEN BEFORE C0 (the hard timing rule): the required-key floor above and the schema string are immutable-within-v1 so every event C0/C1 ever writes replays deterministically. The five-outcome operator_choice enum and the outcome enum only EXTEND (a new operator behavior or outcome value is additive; existing values are never removed or renamed). `correction` is OPTIONAL from v1 so a correcting event needs no schema change. All deferred_additions are OPTIONAL keys.
